ID: `product-marketing`.

## What it does

Looks for the existing marketing document and gathers product, audience, problems, alternatives, differences, objections, customer language and evidence. Can prepare a first draft by reading the repository and pages or build it through progressive questions. Saves the context in .agents/product-marketing.md and retains a history of substantive revisions. Other copy skills use this document as their foundation.

## When to use it

Use it at the start of a project or when positioning, audience, promise or voice changes. It avoids repeating basic information for every landing page. It does not replace user research or missing product evidence.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/product-marketing` in Claude Code or `$product-marketing` in Codex. Provide real materials: README, pages, interviews, feedback and approved data. Request a draft to verify or an update to specific sections. Confirm information before saving; every substantive change retains its version, date and rationale.

## What it delivers

- .agents/product-marketing.md document
- Confirmed information and points to clarify
- Version, date and change history

## Example

Prepare the marketing context by reading the README and landing page. Leave unsourced information open and let me verify the audience, differences and promise before saving it.
